title: sharpness detail on gpu
description:
The sharpness/detail port's follow-through: grade.sharpness and
grade.detail now cross both render seams and the preview seam, so a
grade with the unsharp pair active takes the GPU path instead of
falling back to CPU.

Seam widenings (the raw percents threaded VERBATIM, no clamp at any
layer, because the CPU's own amount mapping clamps the derived amount
to [-0.5, 0.5] — negative values are valid softening, not garbage):

- jni_bridge.cpp: nativeDevelopSessionRenderFrame 35 -> 37 params,
  nativeDevelopSessionRenderFrameToEncoder 37 -> 39 (the pair sits
  right after noiseReduction; rotationDeg stays the tail parameter),
  nativePreviewSessionRenderFrame 36 -> 38. Each req block assigns
  req.sharpness/req.detail verbatim.
- NativeSource.kt: the three external decls + the three wrappers
  widened (no default parameter values — a $default synthetic would
  break the reflection locks).
- M
